apiMessages.content:
Z2 dropped because of missed/cut sessions, not a plan change:

- **W-2 (Jul 20):** 90 min — long run cut to 30 (head cold, HR drifting high, stopped early per your note).
- **W-1 (Jul 27):** 45 min — easy run shortened to 45 (travel week, hotel treadmill), and the Aug 1 long run (120 min planned) wasn't logged as completed at all.

Compare to W-4/W-3 (180, 210 min) when both weekly sessions landed full length. Acute:chronic load ratio is 0.34 (7d avg 45 vs chronic 131) — you're well under your baseline, not at risk, but base-building has stalled the last two weeks.

3/4 of the last 4 weeks completed (75%), block-to-date cardio 525/960 min (55%) — consistent with a real dip, not measurement noise. Per aerobic-base doctrine, closing the AeT gap needs volume; the fix is just getting back on the long-run cadence, starting with Tuesday's Easy Run and Saturday's Long Run this week.
